model.name: R20.25: Method detail links to PUML + TypeScript source code (file:line).
model.description: A METHOD scenario unit's detail view MUST show: (a) link to the PlantUML .puml file where the method's use case is defined, (b) link to the TypeScript source code file:line where the method is implemented. Both clickable. CLICKABLE in detail drawer: (a) clicking puml link opens the .puml file, (b) clicking ts code link NAVIGATES to the TypeScript source at file:line (Monaco opens at that line). Both navigable.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "each type has a link to a source file:line, classes to the puml file and the resulting svg preview, same as methods to the puml AND the ts code, same as tests and gates"

intendedChain.useCase: methodDetail.sourceLinks — Method shows puml link + ts code file:line
intendedChain.test: RED: open R20.25 detail → assert source link(s) present + clickable. Links must be CLICKABLE (navigate on click, not just text). Currently FAILS.

architectDesign.pattern: Method units have TWO source locations: (1) PUML definition (where the method is declared in the use-case diagram), (2) TypeScript implementation (where the [impl:uuid:] marker lives). Both should be linked. The existing model.source covers one; add model.implSource for the other.
architectDesign.impl: Method detail renders two source links: (1) PUML file:line (from model.source), (2) TS file:line (from model.implSource or by resolving the impl unit's sourceFile). fill-source-locations.ts must populate both.
architectDesign.gate: Open a Method detail → PUML link + TS code link both render. PUML → /edit, TS → /edit.
